name: Pelt of the Demon Mother
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 253
Aura faint necromancy CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 3,325 gp; Weight 25 lbs.
Description
This +1 hide armor appears to be made from a horrific amalgam of rotted animal pelts and animal bones, and is usually decorated with the skulls of tiny rodents or vermin and trimmed with the fur of a black wolf. The wearer can use disguise self and unnatural lustUM each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self, unnatural lustUM; Price 1,745 gp
